files.description: The registered b(10) EHI Export documentation page for MedicsDocAssistant v8.0. Contains a single paragraph stating exports are available in CCDA XML and FHIR US Core 3.1.1 format, with links only to external HL7 standards. No vendor-specific data dictionary, schema, or export instructions.
The b(10) page for MedicsCloud v11.0 (sibling product). Identical content to the MedicsDocAssistant B10 page except for product name and version. Saved for completeness.
Screenshot of the B10 EHI Export documentation page as rendered in Chrome browser.

FHIR API documentation for MedicsDocAssistant v8.0 (registered as g(10) API Documentation on CHPL). A 10,568-line Word-to-HTML document describing SMART on FHIR launch, OAuth2 authorization, and 20 US Core resource types with search parameters and sample JSON responses. Mentions Bulk Data 1.0.1 in intro but contains no actual Bulk Data/$export documentation. Relevant to b(10) because the B10 page claims FHIR US Core 3.1.1 as an export format.

FHIR Bundle (JSON) containing Endpoint and Organization resources for all MedicsDocAssistant client practices. Lists production FHIR service URLs for each client. This is g(10) operational infrastructure showing the FHIR service is active across multiple client practices.
Screenshot of the FHIR API documentation page header/intro section as rendered in Chrome browser.
Screenshot of CHPL listing showing the expanded b(10) certification details: Conformance Method is Attestation, Export Documentation URL is the B10 page.

Screenshot of CHPL listing showing the expanded g(10) certification details: API Documentation URL (staging.medicscloud.com), Service Base URL List, USCDI v3, FHIR R4, US Core 6.1.0, SMART App Launch 2.0.0, Bulk Data 1.0.0, Inferno 3.3.2.
